title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #11: Chiricahua Peak and Arizona–New Mexico–Mexico borders
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#11" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "Dos Cabezas Mts.", "cultivated fields", "Chiricahua Peak" (beside a small white cloud), "Douglas" and "U.S. MEXICO", with dashed lines marking the international border and the Arizona–New Mexico state line.
